sources.quote: Zinc exists to accelerate Science-for-Impact innovation, partnering with people and organisations to build a better future for people and the planet. Through our venture building , talent initiatives and innovation partnerships , we work across the entire Science-for-Impact ecosystem to create the conditions, capabilities, and coalitions needed for transformative change. Learn More Zinc’s network of Visiting Fellows are experts and advisors from business, academia, design, technology and the public sector. Fellows support Founders and their newly created ventures by offering expertise in the form of talks, workshops, office hours and access to research and partners. Register Your Interest Zinc works with a range of certified and trained executive coaches who support the personal development of the individuals and teams building their ventures at Zinc. Register Your Interest Partners and investors are individuals and organisations who help Founders and their newly created businesses to gain traction with users and partners to drive growth.
